context: Two cafe friends share weekend impressions
purpose: Teach: 思いつき/はなれ/溢れる/心情/各々/持ち込ん/見受け/ノン

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日の集まり、各々が思いつきで料理持ち込んできて、面白かったよ。
lines.en: Yesterday's gathering was fun — everyone just brought whatever they felt like cooking.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried recollection. Slight rise on the memory of the chaos. Easy, conversational rhythm. Voice settles like she's pleased thinking back on it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね。場が魅力溢れる雰囲気だったでしょ?
lines.en: That sounds lovely. The whole room must have felt so alive, didn't it?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation, leaning in. Soft curiosity — not questioning, affirming. Warm exhale on the question. Unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。私の心情としては、もっと長く話したかった。
lines.en: Yeah. Part of me really wanted the night to keep going.
lines.style: Quieter, more introspective. Slight hesitation before the admission. Trailing softness — a small, honest confession. Not wistful, but genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うちのご近所さんも、見受けたら一人で残ってたって。
lines.en: Actually, my neighbor mentioned she saw someone sitting by themselves after most people had left.
lines.style: Gentle aside, like offering a piece of information she noticed but isn't dwelling on. Even tone, observational. No accusation — just seeing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 席をはなれるタイミング、難しいよね。
lines.en: Yeah, figuring out when it's the right moment to go is harder than you'd think.
lines.style: Knowing nod in the voice. Light, understated agreement. Steady pace — she's thought about this. Small shrug underneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今度はノンアル飲み放題で、もっと気楽に。
lines.en: Next time we should do a no-alcohol bar crawl — lower pressure, more time to just be.
lines.style: Thoughtful planning energy. Gentle lift on the idea, like she's offering a kindness. Warm and practical. Closes like a small gift being handed over.
